newsitem.title: USA: Bristol Technology to acquire Pacific Cash.
newsitem.headline: Bristol Technology to acquire Pacific Cash.

text.p: Bristol Technology Systems Inc Thursday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Pacific Cash Register Co, a San Francisco dealer of point-of-sale systems, for cash and stock.
Details of the transaction were undisclosed. Bristol expects to close the deal in July, it said in a statement.
Pacific Cash Register would become a subsidiary under the continued management of its president, Rob Freaney.
Bristol provides its retail automation products via a network of dealers and systems integrators.
